## Summary
- Harden file-transfer product E2E evidence so both directions must share the same 32-character session ID and retain role artifacts with session metadata.
- Require protocol packet JSONL to carry session/epoch/transfer metadata, ordered chunk offsets, and final chunk markers.
- Add disconnect cleanup closure checks and sync Phase 0 aggregate docs/manifest flags.

## Verification
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_file_transfer_android_smoke tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_gate tools.tests.test_file_transfer_bulk_current_base_manifest tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v
- make phase0-stable-release-gate
- git diff --check origin/main...HEAD

## Safety
- No Host/GUI launch.
- No swift run.
- No adb reverse or TCC/System Settings changes.
title: test(evidence): harden file transfer product artifacts
